name: liquid-glass-mobile-icons

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full icon grid over the leaf, with every tile clear and no cursor crossing it.

tagline: Glassy icon tiles float over a leaf photo like a phone control centre.
summary: A grid of translucent rounded glass tiles holds phone control icons — rotation, notifications, brightness, mute, focus, flashlight, timer, camera and screen record — floating over a photo backdrop.
appearance: A cluster of glassy tiles in two sizes: small round squares for single icons and tall or wide pills for sliders and the Focus toggle. Icons are white outlines on smoky translucent glass with faint inner highlights. They sit over a green leaf beaded with water droplets.
behaviour: The arrangement is static and nothing moves on its own. Each glass tile can be dragged on its own and springs back to its spot, and every tile scales up a little on hover and down on press.
demo_content: A wet green leaf photo behind a grid of phone controls including a Focus pill.
search_phrases: glass icon buttons on a photo
use_when: You want a phone-like cluster of quick toggles laid over a photo or wallpaper.
avoid_when: The icons are decorative with no working toggle state, and the pale icon colour needs a dark backdrop.
customise: The icon set, tile sizes and grid arrangement are written directly in the JSX, so edit the markup to change them. Each tile inherits the glass card's blur, glow and radius defaults.
weight_why: Nine blurred glass tiles, each with a displacement filter and drag handlers.

a11y.note: Each icon has a hidden text label, but the draggable tiles cannot be used from the keyboard.

issues: The first rotation tile uses a misspelled rounded-ful class, so its corners differ from the rest.
Tiles look like controls but clicking them never changes any on or off state.
polish_why: Convincing glass tiles on a strong photo; the icons do nothing and one corner is misspelled.
title: Liquid Glass Mobile Icons
